design.cohort_measure: unmasked observed soft-field count when member first appears
design.controlled_condition: deterministically mask 50% of observed soft fields
design.opportunity_measure: available arrived partners not ruled out by observed reciprocal hard constraints when the member first appears
design.opportunity_limit: not-ruled-out is an opportunity proxy, not proof that missing hard constraints will resolve as feasible
design.bootstrap_cluster: seed with every variant kept together

bootstrap.method: paired percentile bootstrap clustered by seed
bootstrap.resampling_unit: whole seed group with every scenario variant
bootstrap.scenario_weighting: equal weight after within-variant seed means
